invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of HoodieListData.lazy(records), which should not be null.
HoodieListData.lazy likely preserves the number of elements as the input list.
records is passed to HoodieListData.lazy; passing null likely causes an error.
HoodieListData.lazy(records) is expected to return a HoodieData with same backing list.
All elements from records are present in the returned HoodieData.
